# Homeroasters

> > A community-driven platform for home coffee roasting enthusiasts sharing DIY roaster builds, techniques, and equipment knowledge.

Homeroasters.org is centered around the Homeroasters Association community, featuring active contributors like Larry Cotton, EddieDove, Ginny, and Trogster. The site focuses on DIY roaster construction (including drum roasters, heat gun builds, and bean coolers), equipment discussions (R908, ZC Roasters, HVAC Duct Blower), and knowledge sharing through forums, photo galleries, and downloadable resources.

## Key Topics

- home coffee roasting
- DIY roaster builds
- drum roaster construction
- bean cooler designs
- heat gun roasting
- roaster building techniques
- Larry Cotton
- R908 roaster
- ZC Roasters
- HVAC Duct Blower
- Homeroasters Association
- cooling systems
- roasting profiles
- coffee equipment modifications

## Community Forum

- [Main Discussion Forum](https://mail.homeroasters.org/): Central hub for home coffee roasting discussions, build advice, and community interaction

## Resources & Downloads

- [Downloads Library](https://homeroasters.org/downloads.php?cat_id=3): Roasting profiles, DIY build guides, schematics, and technical documentation from the community

## Equipment & Builds

- [Bean Cooler Forum](https://homeroasters.org/forum/viewforum.php?forum_id=67): Discussion and designs for DIY bean cooling systems and cooler modifications
- [Photo Gallery](https://homeroasters.org/photogallery.php): Community-submitted photos of roaster builds, equipment setups, and coffee roasting projects
